name: Flawed Power Stone
summary: Across the Barrens, Flawed Power Stone rests on arcane tables, charged with arcane energy. Its makers left it fatally flawed, so it consumes its own power soon after it is moved.

sections.title: Volatile Craftsmanship
sections.body: In the Barrens, flawed power stones hold arcane essence within compromised structures. Their makers deliberately left them unstable, so they decay into inert matter moments after someone handles them.

sections.title: Self-Consuming Energy
sections.body: A stone begins consuming its power as soon as it leaves the ritual table where it rests. Its energy burns away too quickly for anyone to carry it far.

faq.q: What is a Flawed Power Stone?
faq.answer: Flawed Power Stone holds raw magical power, but its deliberate flaws make it consume itself rapidly once moved.

faq.q: Can the stones be preserved permanently?
faq.answer: No. Once separated from the tables that stabilize them, the stones' magical matrices collapse and their energy quickly runs out.
The orc Ak'Zeloth prepares the stones, and Horde adventurers carry them to the altar of fire on Dreadmist Peak. There, they disrupt the Demon Seed's connection to the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about them?
faq.answer: The Horde uses the stones against the Burning Legion. Ak'Zeloth prepared them for Neeru Fireblade, so carrying one to the altar of fire on Dreadmist Peak can break the Demon Seed's connection to the Legion.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you keep watch over arcane oddities scattered across the Barrens, wary of rogue sorcery that could threaten your supply routes.
